lines.japanese: 目が覚めるとまだ朝だった。
lines.english: When I woke, it was still morning.

lines.japanese: 窓から太陽の光が降りそそぎ、その眩しさに俺は顔をしかめる。
lines.english: Sunlight poured through the window. I grimaced against the glare.

lines.japanese: なんだよ、まだ朝じゃねえか。
lines.english: What the hell? It was *still* morning.

lines.japanese: どうせ俺は夜しか棺の外に出られないドラキュラのドラだ、こんな時間に起こすんじゃねえよブッ殺すぞコノヤロ……お？
lines.english: I was Dora the Dracula, doomed to leave his coffin only at night. Don't wake me at this hour or I'll kill you, ass—hm?
“Morning...?”

lines.japanese: 俺に朝が来たのか。
lines.english: Had morning come for me?

lines.japanese: 俺の夜が明けたのか。
lines.english: Had my long night finally broken into dawn?

lines.japanese: 俺は俺で在りつづけるのか。
lines.english: Would I go on being me?

lines.japanese: 「あー、起きましたー？」
lines.english: “Oh. Awake?”

lines.japanese: 声がした。俺は横たわったままゆっくり頭を起こす。
lines.english: A voice. Still lying down, I slowly raised my head.

lines.japanese: 「おはようございますー。えー、もー、とっくに朝でしたよー」
lines.english: “Good morning. It’s been morning for ages, actually.”

lines.japanese: 窓辺に座った鳴は、ガラスに薄く映りこんだ自分と向かいあって髪を結っていた。俺はその眩しさに目を細めながら、雲の向こうの太陽を睨む。
lines.english: Seated at the window, Naru faced her faint reflection in the glass and tied up her hair. Squinting against her brightness, I glared at the sun beyond the clouds.
“Morning...”

lines.japanese: 「そーです朝です。隼人さんは夜勤だからまだ寝てた方がいいと思いますけどー、私はこれから学校なんですよー」
lines.english: “Yes, morning. You work nights, so you should probably sleep a little longer. I’ve got school, though.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、もう欠席したくないしなー。あーでも一度家まで戻らなきゃなー。あー、ちょっと走らないと遅刻かなー」
lines.english: “Ah, I don’t wanna miss any more classes. Ah, but I’ve gotta go home first. Ah, think I’ll be late if I don’t run?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そうだよな……悪い、自分だけ……」
lines.english: “Yeah, right... Sorry. I was only thinking of myself...”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 鳴が手を止めた。きょとんとした表情は、同じ鏡面に映っている男の寝ぼけ顔を見てるんだろう。俺の素直な謝罪はよほど予想外だったみたいだ。
lines.english: Naru's hands stopped. That blank face must have been looking at the sleep-addled man reflected in the same pane. A plain apology from me was apparently the last thing she'd expected.

lines.japanese: 「あ、やー、私が寝過ぎたのはべつに隼人さんのせいじゃありませんよ、そんな気にしないでください」
lines.english: “Oh, no. It isn't your fault I overslept. Please don't worry about it.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ……そか……」
lines.english: “Yeah... Right...”

lines.japanese: 俺は布団を撥ねのけて半身を起こした。
lines.english: I threw off the covers and pushed myself halfway upright.

lines.japanese: 「ん……おはよ」
lines.english: “Mm... Morning.”

lines.japanese: ようやく意識がはっきりしてきた。
lines.english: At last my mind began to clear.

lines.japanese: この朝が特別なものであるという実感が湧いてくる。
lines.english: It began to sink in that this morning was special.

lines.japanese: これは俺にとって──
lines.english: For me, this was—

lines.japanese: ──いや、おまえも含めた俺たち全員にとって、新しい生が始まる朝だ。
lines.english: —no. For all of us, you included, this was the morning a new life began.

lines.japanese: 「おはよう」
lines.english: “Good morning.”

lines.japanese: 俺はもう一度口にした。
lines.english: I said it once more.

lines.japanese: 俺の中の俺たちに。
lines.english: To everyone inside me.

lines.japanese: 新しい俺が留まる世界に。
lines.english: To the world where this new me had chosen to remain.

lines.japanese: 俺が共に過ごすことを選んだ相手、鳳鳴に。
lines.english: To the person I had chosen to share that life with: Naru Otori.

lines.japanese: 「あのー、まだ寝ぼけてますー？」
lines.english: “Um. Are you still half asleep?”

lines.japanese: 「ん、ぼちぼち……」
lines.english: “Mm. More or less...”

lines.japanese: その場で伸びをした。
lines.english: I stretched where I sat.

lines.japanese: 愛した女と迎える朝に感謝した。
lines.english: I was grateful to greet the morning with the woman I loved.

lines.japanese: この先ふたり共にいられることを実感した。
lines.english: I felt the truth of it: from here on, we could go on together.

lines.japanese: 俺は留まることができた。もう大丈夫。鳴さえいなくならない限りは。
lines.english: I had managed to stay. Everything would be all right now, as long as Naru didn't disappear.

lines.japanese: いなく……ならない限りは……
lines.english: As long as she... didn't disappear...

lines.japanese: いなく……ならないよな……？
lines.english: She wouldn't... would she...?

lines.japanese: 「あのー、なんでしょー、私なんか付いてますかー？」
lines.english: “Um, what is it? Do I have something on me?”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　あァ……いや、そうじゃなくて……」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh... No, that's not...”

lines.japanese: どうやら俺は鳴の後ろ姿を凝視したまま固まっていたらしい。
lines.english: Apparently I had frozen, staring at Naru's back.

lines.japanese: この不意に降って湧いたような不安はなんなのだろう。
lines.english: Where had this sudden fear come from?

lines.japanese: 愛を知るほどに孤独を恐れる、千歳鷲介という男の存在をふと思いだした。
lines.english: I remembered Shusuke Chitose, the man who feared solitude more deeply the more he learned to love.

lines.japanese: この不安が孤独を恐れてのものだとしたら、あえて俺は恋に堕ちた少年のように愚かしい問いを投げよう。
lines.english: If this unease was the fear of being alone, then I would let myself ask the foolish question of a boy in love.

lines.japanese: 「あんさ……おまえ、どっかいなくなったりしないよな」
lines.english: “Listen... You aren't going to up and disappear on me, are you?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 呆然とさせてしまった。
lines.english: I had left her dumbfounded.

lines.japanese: ま、そりゃそうだ。俺自身なんで急にこんなことを言いだしたのかよく分からない。
lines.english: Well, of course. Even I didn't know why I'd suddenly said such a thing.

lines.japanese: 「えー、あの、あなたひとの話聞いてます？　もちろん行きますよ。私いまから学校行くって言いましたよ」
lines.english: “Um, do you listen when people talk? Of course I'm going. I just told you I'm leaving for school.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、それは聞いたけど、そういうことじゃなくてよ」
lines.english: “No, I heard that. That's not what I meant.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、なんでしょー。すみません、準備が整い次第出かけますんで、愛の囁きでしたら後日うけたまわりますけど」
lines.english: “Then what is it? Sorry, but I’m leaving as soon as I’m ready. If this is a declaration of love, I can hear it another day.”

lines.japanese: やつは手の動きを速めながら、しかし刺々しくならないよう気遣った声で言う。
lines.english: Her hands moved faster, but she took care not to let her voice grow sharp.

lines.japanese: 要望通り、俺は単刀直入に聞いた。
lines.english: As requested, I asked her straight out.

lines.japanese: 「だから、たとえば……おまえ、そのうちオランダ戻ったりしねーよな」
lines.english: “I mean, for example... You aren't going to move back to the Netherlands one day, are you?”
“Ah.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、まー、そんなん急に聞かれたって困るかもしんねーけど……」
lines.english: “Well, sure, maybe you can't answer something like that out of nowhere...”

lines.japanese: ああ、なんか猛烈に恥ずかしくなってきた。
lines.english: God, I was suddenly mortified.

lines.japanese: ああ、くそくそくそ、なんでこんなワケわかんねーこと聞いてんだ俺。だから恋愛は嫌いなんだ、ハードボイルドでいられなくなる。俺は後ろ頭をがっしゃがっしゃ血が出るほど掻きまくった。
lines.english: Damn it, damn it, damn it. Why was I asking this incomprehensible crap? This was why I hated romance. It made staying hard-boiled impossible. I raked the back of my head hard enough to draw blood.

lines.japanese: 「なんでもねー、なんでもねー。忘れろ忘れろ」
lines.english: “Never mind. Nothing. Forget it, forget it.”

lines.japanese: 「それは……」
lines.english: “Does that...”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「それはつまり結婚しようということですか」
lines.english: “Does that mean you're asking me to marry you?”

lines.japanese: 「ハア？」
lines.english: “WHAT?!”

lines.japanese: 今度は俺が驚く番だった。
lines.english: Now it was my turn to be shocked.

lines.japanese: 「ひとつずつ段階を踏んできた私たちの恋も、とうとう終盤戦に差しかかったわけですね。恋から愛へ……そして家族の情へと移ろいゆくのですね。はー、長かったー」
lines.english: “Our love has advanced one careful step at a time, and at last entered its endgame. Romance becomes love... then love matures into the affection of family. Ah, what a long road.”

lines.japanese: 鳴の目は恍惚に潤んでいた。ギャグ……なのか？　本気なのか？　どっちだコレ。
lines.english: Naru's eyes shimmered with rapture. A joke...? Serious? Which was this?

lines.japanese: ああ、いつものパターンか。つまり冗談５０％でコーティングした、半分本気。
lines.english: Oh, right. Her usual pattern: half serious beneath a fifty-percent coating of jokes.

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿か、おまえ。結婚なんて単語どっから出てきたんだよ。俺いま、オランダ戻る可能性はあんのかって聞いただけなんだけど」
lines.english: “Are you an idiot? Where'd marriage come from? I only asked whether you might go back to the Netherlands.”

lines.japanese: 「え、だから要は、どこにも行くな鳴おまえを放しはしない～ってことですよね」
lines.english: “Yes, which fundamentally means, ‘Go nowhere, Naru. I shall never let you go,’ does it not?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、まァ、ニュアンスとしちゃ間違ってねえけど」
lines.english: “Well... That's more or less the right idea.”
“Haugh!”

lines.japanese: 胸を掴んでのけぞった。
lines.english: She clutched her chest and arched backward.

lines.japanese: しょうもねえ。オチまでいつものパターンじゃねえか。
lines.english: Ridiculous. Even the punch line followed her usual pattern.

lines.japanese: 「まあいいや。おまえいま急いでんだろ。続きは夜にでもしよう」
lines.english: “Whatever. You're in a hurry, right? We'll continue tonight.”

lines.japanese: 「きゃー、待ちあわせですかー。デートですかー」
lines.english: “Eee! Are we meeting? Is it a date?”

lines.japanese: 「デートっつうか」
lines.english: “A date, huh...”

lines.japanese: そんなことでいちいち喜ぶ必要はねえだろ。これからはずっと一緒なんだから。
lines.english: There was no need to celebrate every little thing. From now on, we'd always be together.

lines.japanese: なんて言葉はもちろん呑みこんだ。言えるかそんなん。
lines.english: Naturally, I swallowed the words. Like hell I could say them aloud.

lines.japanese: 「じゃデートでいいけど」
lines.english: “Fine. Call it a date.”

lines.japanese: 「にへー」
lines.english: “Hee.”

lines.japanese: 鳴がとろけるように笑う。
lines.english: Naru melted into a smile.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ学校終わって１７時とかどう」
lines.english: “How about five, after school?”

lines.japanese: 「はいっ！　パルクレープで待ってます！」
lines.english: “Yes! I'll wait at Paru Crêpes!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そだ、もいっこ質問していい」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Can I ask one more thing?”

lines.japanese: 「え、え、いまですか？　あー、急いでるって言ってるのになんだろ……ええじゃあハイなんですか」
lines.english: “What? Now? I told you I'm in a hurry... Fine, yes. What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「あんさ、おまえハーフなのに、なんで下の毛パツ金じゃねーの？」
lines.english: “You’re half Dutch, so how come the rest of your hair isn’t blond?”

lines.japanese: 「わー、なんだこのひと、せっかくのめでたしめでたしを台無しにしやがったー」
lines.english: “Wow. Look at this man, ruining our lovely happily-ever-after.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だって気になンじゃん。おまえの母ちゃんパツ金なんでしょ。じゃなんでおまえパツ金じゃねーの」
lines.english: “It’s a fair question. Your mother’s blond, right? So why aren’t you blond?”

lines.japanese: 「あのー、でしたら普通に、毛髪に関して尋ねていただくだけで結構だと思うんですがー」
lines.english: “If you were curious, I believe asking about the hair on my head would have been perfectly sufficient.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そっか。や、でも、なんか下の方が気になんじゃん」
lines.english: “Oh, right. But somehow I was more curious about the rest.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、すみません、劣性遺伝って言葉を勝手に調べといてください」
lines.english: “Please look up the term ‘recessive trait’ on your own.”

lines.japanese: 「ん……？　いや実は、もしかして微妙に金だった？　なあ悪りい、ちょっと、一本抜いて見せてくんない」
lines.english: “Hm...? Wait, was it actually faintly blond? Hey, sorry, but could you pull one out and show me?”

lines.japanese: 「わー、ほんと台無しー」
lines.english: “Wow. Completely ruined.”
